### F5TTS_v1_Base config — dataset and tokenizer

Source: https://github.com/swivid/f5-tts/blob/main/src/f5_tts/configs/F5TTS_v1_Base.yaml

The training dataset is Emilia_ZH_EN (Chinese & English only), tokenizer is pinyin (Chinese-specific), and a tokenizer_path field exists for custom vocabs. This confirms no official support for Vietnamese or other languages out of the box.

```yaml
datasets:
  name: Emilia_ZH_EN  # dataset name

model:
  name: F5TTS_v1_Base  # model name
  tokenizer: pinyin  # tokenizer type
  tokenizer_path: null  # if 'custom' tokenizer, define the path want to use (should be vocab.txt)
```

### Arabic > F5-TTS Small @ ar & en @ SILMA AI

Source: https://github.com/swivid/f5-tts/blob/main/src/f5_tts/infer/SHARED.md

Model: F5-TTS Small. Hugging Face: ckpt & vocab available at silma-ai/silma-tts. Data: Tens of thousands EN/AR. Model License: Apache-2.0. Pretrained by SILMA.AI. GitHub repo: https://github.com/SILMA-AI/silma-tts, Inference code.

--------------------------------

### French

Source: https://github.com/swivid/f5-tts/blob/main/src/f5_tts/infer/SHARED.md

The F5-TTS Base model for French is available on Hugging Face, trained on LibriVox data with a cc-by-nc-4.0 license. It also links to an online inference space, a tutorial video for training new language models, and a GitHub discussion.

--------------------------------

### German

Source: https://github.com/swivid/f5-tts/blob/main/src/f5_tts/infer/SHARED.md

The F5-TTS Base model for German is available on Hugging Face, trained on Mozilla Common Voice and crowdsourced data, with a cc-by-nc-4.0 license. It was finetuned by @hvoss-techfak.

--------------------------------

### Inference

Source: https://github.com/swivid/f5-tts/blob/main/src/f5_tts/infer/README.md

Pretrained model checkpoints are available on Hugging Face and Model Scope, and will be automatically downloaded when running inference scripts. More checkpoints supporting additional languages can be found in SHARED.md.
